description: From near the Mirador de la Catedral, look northeast across Albarracín's old town at night. The village's warm-lit houses step down the hillside across the frame, the castle's defensive wall ridge running along the top. In the dark, only window lights and the lit wall trace the old town's shape against the night hills.

Scenario 23 September 2026 23:07 Europe/Madrid, true late night, no twilight glow. Open-Meteo model valid23:00:17.1C, clear0% cloud,0 precipitation, wind5km/h. Sky almost black, no visible moon or stars, no clouds. Warm street lighting and restrained historical-reference-informed wall lighting, not a claim of tonight's schedule. Composition anchors: dense irregular pink/ochre plaster houses with clay tiled roofs on steep rocky terrain; a small square church belfry amid clustered roofs; crenellated walls with square towers stepping up a bare rugged hill behind, not a continuous fantasy castle. Dark Guadalaviar ravine at right. Camera a little pulled back with main hill, walls and roof cluster held inside central44% of image width for a whole-landmark portrait crop; realistic peripheral rooftops and ravine extending sideways.
